svg.aria-label: A volcano plot of a DESeq2 result. Each dot is a gene. Horizontally its log2 fold change between LPS and control, vertically minus log10 of the adjusted p-value. Genes beyond a fold change of 2 in either direction and below padj 0.05 are differentially expressed: up-regulated ones such as Ccr7, Il12b and Cd86 on the right, down-regulated ones on the left.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Volcano plot
svg.text: A volcano plot: each dot is a gene; DEGs pass both thresholds
right/left = how much it changed; up = how sure we are (FDR-adjusted p, padj)
